heroTitle: Find Your Perfect Home in the DMV Area
heroSubtitle: With 14 years of expertise across the DMV market, Alex Johnson delivers results-driven real estate services tailored to your goals.
aboutBio:
A lifelong DMV resident, I grew up watching the region transform into one of the most dynamic real estate markets in the country. After earning a degree in Business Administration from the University of Maryland, I discovered my passion for helping people navigate one of the biggest decisions of their lives.

Over the past 14 years, I've closed more than 500 transactions — from cozy Capitol Hill condos and Bethesda single-families to Northern Virginia investment properties.

I'm known for my straight-talking approach, obsessive market research, and fierce advocacy for my clients.
